title: Google partners with Ambani’s Reliance to offer free AI Pro access to millions of Jio users in India
description: U.S. tech giants increasingly view India as the next big frontier — a place to gather diverse data, refine models, and test AI use cases that could later scale across other emerging markets.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Figma acquires AI-powered media generation company Weavy
description: Figma said that Weavy will exist as a stand-alone product for now and that, in the future, it will be integrated with the Figma Weave brand, along with the rest of the Figma platform.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: The Prompting Company snags $6.5M to help products get mentioned in ChatGPT and other AI apps
description: Retailers could see up to a 520% increase in traffic from chatbots and AI prompts in 2025 compared to 2024, according to the report. For brands, that means figuring out how to show up in AI-generated recommendations, and fast.
author: Tage Kene-Okafor

title: Cluely’s Roy Lee on the rage-bait strategy for startup marketing
description: Cluely's Roy Lee has a message for startup founders: You should be thinking harder about how to go viral.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko is a big fan of agentic coding
description: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Yakovenko said he's become increasingly comfortable taking a back seat in software development tasks.
author: Russell Brandom
